text:
HSTU’s relevant computations are pointwise SiLU attention, relative positional/temporal bias, normalized value aggregation, and multiplicative gating before output projection/residual addition. These provide candidate intervention sites; inspect the supplied implementation before assuming every component exists. The [HSTU paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17152) and [official implementation](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/generative_recommenders/research/modeling/sequential/hstu.py) establish architecture, not mechanistic faithfulness. No directly matching HSTU activation-patching study surfaced in this search.

[Activation-patching guidance (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.15255) distinguishes clean→corrupted restoration from corrupted→clean disruption: they test different aspects of sufficiency and necessity, conditional on the intervention distribution. [ICLR 2024 methodological experiments](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/file/06a52a54c8ee03cd86771136bc91eb1f-Paper-Conference.pdf) show that corruption methods and evaluation metrics can substantially change localization. Use continuous target-versus-comparator score differences alongside rank/HR@10; threshold metrics alone conceal effects. Input deletion or shuffling measures history sensitivity but does not identify the computation mediating it.

Proposed adaptation for the single frozen checkpoint: cache matched history runs, patch gates, aggregated values, or block outputs individually, then test hypothesized paths. Require same-run identity patches to reproduce scores, hooks disabled to recover baseline, deterministic evaluation, unchanged padding/causal masks, and final-nonpadding readout. Match donor histories on length and positions; vary donors and corruption types. Treat bias-zeroing or gate-neutralization as controlled ablations with possible distribution shifts. Measure activation norms and downstream changes, report raw effects when restoration denominators approach zero, and confirm findings across users. These are proposed controls, not established HSTU findings; causal conclusions remain specific to tested histories and interventions, without implying validation improvement or generalization.
